content.text: In Nigeria, Stripe and PayPal block 90% of digital creators from collecting [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-5|COREMERCH guide to payments]]. Gumroad and Paddle flag transactions as high-risk. Your solution is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. This guide deploys a sovereign digital store using Supabase as your order database, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-4|GitHub Pages]] Pages for hosting, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. No platforms. No subscriptions. Full ownership from day one. Built for creators [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal-which-architecture-actually-4|selling]] ebooks, courses, templates, and digital products in regions where conventional payment systems fail.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they rent you access to their systems. This infrastructure owns the stack. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront for free, unblockable by regional restrictions. Supabase stores orders in a PostgreSQL database you control, not a third-party SaaS. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain without KYC, using webhooks to trigger product delivery. The backend runs on Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers—both free, both serverless. No single point of failure. No platform dependency. Your store operates on infrastructure you own, configured to your rules.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, secure your domain—Cloudflare offers free DNS with DDoS protection. Set up a Supabase account for order storage and a NOWPayments account for crypto processing. Choose BSC, Solana, or TRON for transaction fees under $0.10. Install the GitHub CLI or Cloudflare Wrangler for deployment. Load your digital products into Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Write your product descriptions and pricing in a Google Sheet or Airtable. Test your payment flow on testnet before mainnet deployment. This preparation ensures your store launches without delays.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Configure NOWPayments to listen for transactions on your chosen network. Set the webhook URL to your backend script hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Workers. When payment confirms, the webhook triggers a function to log the order in Supabase and generate a secure download link from Google Drive or R2. Use JWTs for time-limited access. Test the flow with small testnet transactions. Ensure Supabase writes are atomic and link generation is instantaneous. This pipeline automates payment verification, order storage, and product delivery without manual intervention.
Your store runs on infrastructure you own—no platforms, no subscriptions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your frontend to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Point your domain to the live URL. Promote your store with a link to your products—example: https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Monitor Supabase for incoming orders and NOWPayments for transaction confirmations. Process your first live transaction manually if needed, then automate fully. Document every step for future reference. Your store is now operational, accepting crypto payments globally without platform interference.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once live, scale by adding products to your Supabase database and updating your frontend. Use Cloudflare Workers for edge logic to handle increased traffic. Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a fully deployed, end-to-end tested stack with SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. Add analytics with Google Sheets or Supabase queries. Optimize for mobile and SEO. Your infrastructure is now a foundation, not a limitation. Build on it without asking permission.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store accepting crypto payments for free, deploy Stack 01 from COREMERCH’s Sovereign Blueprint. Use GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. This stack costs nothing to deploy and operates on free tiers. For a fully managed solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys Stack 02 in 48 hours, end-to-end tested with 5 products loaded.
Supabase and NOWPayments replace Stripe and PayPal with zero platform risk.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re deploying Stack 01, follow the Sovereign Blueprint to complete the setup in 4-6 hours. For a fully managed deployment, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, configured and tested in 48 hours. Both stacks give you full ownership of your infrastructure. Explore products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to start.
Your Deployment Checklist

Secure your domain and DNS through Cloudflare. Set up Supabase for order storage and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Install GitHub CLI or Cloudflare Wrangler. Load products into Google Drive or R2. Write product details in a Google Sheet. Test payment flow on testnet. Deploy backend to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Workers. Configure webhook for payment verification. Deploy frontend and point your domain. Promote your store and monitor transactions.
Frequently Asked Questions
What’s the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and Supabase, deployed in 4-6 hours. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing and 5 products loaded.
Can I use this infrastructure in Venezuela?
Yes. The infrastructure bypasses regional payment restrictions by using crypto payments and free hosting. Deploy Stack 01 or Stack 02 to accept payments globally without platform interference.
How do I handle refunds in this system?
Refunds are processed manually by sending crypto back to the buyer’s wallet. Log the refund in Supabase for record-keeping. Automate refund requests with a form connected to your backend.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on decentralized networks. If their service fails, payments still confirm on-chain. Reconfigure webhooks to a backup script or use a self-hosted payment verifier.
Can I add more products after deployment?
Yes. Add products to your Supabase database and update your frontend. For Stack 02, COREMERCH includes 5 products loaded and tested. Scale as needed without redeploying the core infrastructure.
Deploy once, own forever. Scale without asking permission.
